name: Performance
description: Users report slow response, crashes, scrolling glitches, and voice quality problems.

name: Limits & Paywall
description: Frequent complaints about daily image/chat limits and the push to upgrade to premium.

name: Accuracy
description: Issues with wrong or incomplete answers, hallucinations, and censorship of generated content.

name: UI/UX
description: Feedback on interface quirks, settings, dark mode, conversation persistence, and attachment handling.
